title: Show Bluetooth devices ordered by last used
line: The Bluetooth applet and settings page now list the devices you used most recently first, instead of alphabetically.
explanation: BlueZ keeps no last-used time on D-Bus, so the device list could only sort by name, and paired devices always showed up alphabetically below the connected ones. The bluedevil daemon now writes the time each paired device connects and disconnects to bluedevilglobalrc ([LastConnected], UTC, with KConfig notify). The shared DevicesProxyModel (applet and KCM) reads it, watches it with KConfigWatcher, and sorts each section by most recent use, then by name for devices never used since the change.

commits.message:
applet: sort devices by when they were last used

Paired devices were always listed by name, so daily headphones could sit
below devices unused for months. The daemon now records when each device
was last connected, and the applet and KCM list recent ones first.

BUG: 489245

media.caption: Before: Sony and then JBL were just used, but the list stays alphabetical
After: same steps, JBL and Sony (most recent first) lead the Available list
After: using Keychron K2 with the popup open moves it to the top right away
